tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You are a university student working on a group project for one of your classes. One of your group members, Jake, has not been contributing to the project and has missed several meetings. This is affecting the progress of the project, and you need to address the issue with him.
Write an email to Jake. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe the importance of the project.
Explain how his absence has affected the group’s progress.
Suggest ways he can help the group.
tasks.to: Jake Subject: Need your contribution to the group project
tasks.subject: Need your contribution to the group project
tasks.title: Write an Email
